inlines.v: FAT'NESS, noun [from fat.] 1. The quality of being fat, plump, or full fed; corpulency; fullness of flesh. Their eyes stand out with fatness Psalms 73:7. 2. Unctuous or greasy matter. 3. Unctuousness; sliminess; applied to earth:hence richness; fertility; fruitfulness. God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine. Genesis 27:28. 4. That which gives fertility. Thy paths drop fatness Psalms 65:11. The clouds drop fatness 5. The privileges and pleasures of religion; abundant blessings. Let your soul delight itself in fatness Isaiah 55:2.
